Just looking around?

A simple CSV works best.

Export a CSV from your bank, then select the date, description and amount columns. This version reads INR statements only.

Date,Description,Debit,Credit

Separate debit/credit columns and a single amount column are supported. For a single column, select the sign convention or a DR/CR type column.

Indian date formats, ISO dates, quoted descriptions and rupee amounts are supported. Unsupported or invalid rows are listed for review; no transactions are silently removed.

Categories are estimates based on descriptions. Transfers, refunds and unusual charges may need your review. Statement data cannot identify a device or block a payment.
